description: Agent Water Records: submit water treatment plant records with the operating log, chemical stock and calibration entries they answer to: the reading moment; each daily operating log entry with its id, reference, the plant, the operator on duty and the operating day; each disinfectant residual reading with its id, reference, the plant, the residual, the minimum residual the record states and the moment read; each chemical feed entry with its id, reference, the plant, the chemical, the amount fed and the moment fed; each chemical delivery or stock entry with its id, reference, the plant, the chemical and the moment delivered or counted; each instrument calibration entry with its id, reference, the plant, the instrument, the moment calibrated and the moment the next calibration is due. The signed report gives the treatment entries and the records behind them, each residual reading against the operating log entry for its plant and day, each residual against the minimum the record states, each chemical fed against a delivery or stock entry for its plant on or before the day fed, and each calibration due against a later calibration of its instrument, and counts them, and names divergent water treatment records: a residual reading with no operating log entry for its plant and day, a residual below the minimum the record states, a chemical fed with no delivery or stock entry behind it, and an instrument calibration due with none recorded; then a chemical feed on a day with no operating log entry and an operating log entry naming no operator on duty, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No residual readings, no operating log beside readings or feeds, or no stock entries beside feeds leaves those points unverified. Plants and entries match by letters and digits, chemicals and instruments by their words with plurals folded, figures as written in the unit the record uses, dates by the day, an entry naming no plant reads against any plant, a residual equal to its minimum meets it, and a calibration due after the reading moment waits. This reads a treatment plant’s own operating records, from the daily log to the chemical stock and the instrument calibrations. Verdict water_treatment_record_divergent, water_treatment_record_partial, water_treatment_record_unverified or water_treatment_record_consistent. POST /api/water-treatment-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.

next_due_at.description: When the next calibration is due, such as 2026-03-02.

amount.description: Amount fed, in the unit the record uses.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

minimum.description: Amount the record states as the minimum residual, in the unit the record uses.

residual.description: Amount of disinfectant residual, in the unit the record uses.

stock.description: Each chemical delivery or stock entry.

at.description: When delivered or counted, such as 2026-03-02.

ref.description: The delivery or stock entry reference.
